description: Advisory, fail-open Oydodo core principles for local Agent sessions.

hooks.command: root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -n "$root" ]; then file="$root/core/always-on.md"; if [ -f "$file" ] && [ -r "$file" ]; then payload=$(cat "$file" 2>/dev/null) || payload=; if [ -n "$payload" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$payload"; fi; fi; fi; exit 0
